ROLE: Borrow the descriptor owned by a session, or -1 when there is none, so callers can register/synchronize a descriptor without owning it.

STRUCT.NAME: struct session
STRUCT.ROLE: source of the owned descriptor number

LOGIC.INPUT: s: borrowed session pointer, possibly NULL.
LOGIC.ACTION: 1) If s is NULL return -1. 2) Return s->fd. The value is read only; this function never closes, registers or modifies the descriptor, and it does not take ownership. After session_close_immediately() the field is -1, so the returned value becomes -1 and a caller that later registers the descriptor would use -1 (an invalid epoll target) rather than a recycled descriptor number.
LOGIC.OUTPUT: -1 for a NULL session or for a session whose descriptor has already been closed; otherwise the nonnegative descriptor number owned by the session.
INVARIANTS_USED: a session owns at most one descriptor at a time
the descriptor field is -1 exactly when the descriptor is already released
reading session state is observation only and must not change ownership
LOGIC.PRECONDITION: s is NULL or points to a live session that has not been destroyed.
LOGIC.THREAD_SAFETY: Not thread safe with respect to concurrent mutation of s.

EXPECT.note: never returns a recycled descriptor number
